entry.title: AvaloniaUI/Avalonia - Releases - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
12.1.4

What's Changed

Enhancements

  • Core – Make DiagnosticTextRenderer numbers monospace by @qwertychouskie in #21860
  • Controls – Release the TextBlock text layout when the control is detached by @ronnycohen in #22281
  • Controls – Implement expand/collapse and invoke for MenuItem automation by @grokys in #22295
  • Windows – Gate per-monitor DPI on GetDpiForMonitor availability by @Davide244 in #22299
  • Wayland – Add AppId in WaylandPlatformOptions and WaylandProperties by @Whiletru3 in #22209

Fixes

  • Core – Fix showing ellipsis when word wrap and limited by height or MaxLines by @appel1 in #22025
  • Core – Stop radial gradients with a moved origin from hiding the background by @Evan260 in #22241
  • Core – Fix duplicate insertion of shared StyleInstance into the same ValueStore by @DamirLisak in #22276
  • Core – Fix bidi explicit formatting after reset by @George-Payne in #22288
  • Core – Revert "Fix StreamGeometry Clone and Open when a Transform is set (#22213)" by @MrJul in #22294
  • Core – Fix StreamGeometry Clone and Open when a Transform is set by @Evan260 in #22303
  • Core – Fix re-attaching a child visual cleared on detach by @Gillibald in #22334
  • Core – Return empty text bounds for zero-length ranges by @adirh3 in #22344
  • Core – Fix keyboard focus staying on a removed element when an overlay popup or flyout closes by @dariostrm in #22345
  • Core – Release detached visuals from a stopped CompositingRenderer by @NathanDrake2406 in #22369
  • Core – Fix RunIndex mapping in BidiReorderer by @niksedk in #22384
  • Core – Fix comments for PreciseArcTo by @robloo in #22402
  • Core – Fix Arc calculation and update ArcSegment comments by @robloo in #22404
  • Core – Fix ArgumentNullException in chrome hit test after window close by @AtakanUk in #22409
  • Controls – Report deselected items and batch SelectAll in TreeView by @Evan260 in #22172
  • Controls – Fix caret position with centered text by @chenjt2001 in #22340
  • Controls – Batch TextBox selection notifications during text replacement by @adirh3 in #22343
  • Controls – Invalidate Polygon/Polyline geometry when the points collection changes by @Gobidev in #22346
  • Controls – Hide text selection handles when text presenter visibility changes by @emmauss in #22348
  • Controls – Keep the CalendarDatePicker drop-down open when focus returns to it by @Evan260 in #22354
  • Controls – Apply IsSelected from items declared in XAML by @Evan260 in #22363
  • Controls – Keep the initial position of a Popup with pointer placement mode when its size changes by @emmauss in #22366
  • Controls – Fix Button and MenuItem leak when a style sets Command by @NathanDrake2406 in #22367
  • Controls – Update NativeMenuItem enabled state when CommandParameter changes by @NathanDrake2406 in #22368
  • Controls – Allow Shift+Tab out of CalendarDatePicker by @NathanDrake2406 in #22370
  • Controls – Do not measure TextBlock embedded controls during a render pass by @Gillibald in #22394
  • Controls – Fix support for HorizontalAlignment in ColorPicker by @robloo in #22401
  • Windows – Drive Win32 composition effects from RenderTargetSceneInfo on the render thread by @kekekeks in #22114
  • Windows – Read automation providers on the UI thread in Win32 automation by @Evan260 in #22237
  • Windows – Fix stale screen information in tray-only Win32 apps by @Cuptu in #22374
  • Linux – Expose heading and list metadata over AT-SPI by @glennawatson in #22383
  • Browser – Install dispatcher sync context in JS export callbacks by @kekekeks in #22293

Full Changelog: 12.1.3...12.1.4

entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
4.0.350.0

4.0.350.0 (2026-10-09 18:13 UTC)

  • ARCRegionswitch (4.0.103.3)
    • ARCRegionswitch is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • Athena (4.0.100.17)
    • Athena is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • AWSMarketplaceMetering (4.0.101.0)
    • AWS Marketplace Metering Service adds AgreementId to ResolveCustomer API response.
  • CloudWatchOmni (4.0.100.3)
    • CloudWatchOmni is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • Deadline (4.0.103.0)
    • The new ListMemberships API enables users to discover their memberships across Deadline Cloud resources, enabling scoped users of Deadline resources to discover and interact with the resources they have been provided scoped access to.
  • MediaTailor (4.0.108.0)
    • Add caching settings to http functions
  • QuickSight (4.0.111.0)
    • Adds granular custom permissions for the Gong action connector (GongAction, CreateAndUpdateGongAction, ShareGongAction, UseGongAction) and for create, update, and share operations on 45 data source connectors, such as Amazon S3 and Snowflake, through the Custom Permissions APIs.
  • SecurityAgent (4.0.112.0)
    • Adds a test scope field to specify whether a pentest targets a web application or a generative AI application.
  • Snowball (4.0.100.17)
    • Snowball is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage_5.3.10

5.3.10 (2026-10-09)

Other Changes

Please refer to Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extension.Storage.Blobs and Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extension.Storage.Queues for detailed list of changes.

Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage.Queues_5.3.10

5.3.10 (2026-10-09)

Other Changes

  • This release contains bug fixes to improve quality.

Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage.Blobs_5.3.10

5.3.10 (2026-10-09)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed a regression from 5.3.8 where a complete (single-page) container scan could skip blobs whose LastModified was after PollingStartTime, then advance the stored scan watermark past those blobs so listing never notified them (#62763).
  • Fixed container scan not starting a new cycle when the listing API returns an empty continuation marker instead of null, which left PollingStartTime stuck and hid blobs uploaded after the first sweep (#61660).

Azure.ResourceManager.NetworkCloud_1.4.0

1.4.0 (2026-10-08)

Features Added

  • Added AdministrativeCredentialsPatch, BareMetalMachineConfigurationPatch, ClusterSecretArchivePatch, ClusterUpdateStrategyPatch, ImageRepositoryCredentialsPatch, NetworkCloudRackDefinitionPatch, NetworkCloudSshPublicKeyPatch, RuntimeProtectionConfigurationPatch, ServicePrincipalInformationPatch, StorageApplianceConfigurationPatch, and ValidationThresholdPatch models to align the update/patch payloads with their corresponding patch semantics.

Azure.Provisioning.Cdn_1.0.0-beta.4

1.0.0-beta.4 (2026-10-09)

Bugs Fixed

  • Restored the beta.2 resource name requirements lost during the TypeSpec
    migration for FrontDoorEndpoint, FrontDoorOriginGroup, FrontDoorOrigin,
    and FrontDoorRoute. Generated names again allow uppercase letters, numbers,
    and hyphens, with maximum lengths of 46 for endpoints and 90 for origin
    groups, origins, and routes instead of the beta.3 inherited 24-character
    lowercase defaults. Generated resource names may therefore differ when
    upgrading from beta.3.

Azure.Provisioning.Fabric_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-10-09)

Features Added

  • Initial preview of Azure.Provisioning.Fabric.

Azure.Provisioning.VerifiedId_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-10-09)

Features Added

  • Initial beta release of Azure.Provisioning.VerifiedId.

Azure.ResourceManager.NapsterOmniagentApi_1.0.0

1.0.0 (2026-09-23)

Features Added

  • Upgraded to API version 2026-08-11.

Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerService_1.8.0

1.8.0 (2026-10-08)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-07-01.

Azure.ResourceManager.CosmosDB_1.6.0-beta.1

1.6.0-beta.1 (2026-09-22)

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version to 2026-04-01-preview.

Other Changes

  • Upgraded dependent Azure.Core to 1.62.0.

entry.title: StackExchange/StackExchange.Redis - Releases - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
4.0.99-alpha

#3262

3.4.0

Major Changes

  • In RESP3, by default the library now uses separate connections for pub/sub; see #3264
  • Smart-client-handoffs is now enabled by default on Redis Enterprise and AMR; see #3248
  • Some logging events incorrectly used duplicated ids - resolved; see #3266

All Changes

  • Recover promptly from a cluster failover; fix the configuration channel under RESP3 and with a channel prefix (#3254) by @mgravell in #3255
  • Preserve binary members as VectorSetRange bounds by @Laurianti in #3256
  • Smart client handoffs: reinstate auto-enlistment for the hosted providers and remove [Experimental] by @mgravell in #3248
  • docs: fix retry-category test in the custom RetryPolicy sample by @mgravell in #3265
  • Fix duplicate LoggerMessage event ids; add a guard test by @mgravell in #3266
  • Scan: observe the faults of abandoned page tasks after a sync timeout or dispose (#3260) by @mgravell in #3267
  • Report the outcome of every physical connection attempt, identifying the client certificate used by @mgravell in #3257
  • Use a dedicated pub/sub connection under RESP3 by default by @mgravell in #3264

Tooling

  • docs(agents): add create-implementation-plan-for-redis-api-change skill by @uglide in #3268

New Contributors

  • @Laurianti made their first contribution in #3256

Full Changelog: 3.3.1...3.4.0
